defect.foreign_key_ordering: PRAGMA foreign_keys is connection-local and must be active before the transaction; enabling it inside the schema script is not an admissible substitute for connection-open enforcement

mechanism: require PRAGMA foreign_keys=1 before cognition schema install
replace executescript with four ordinary CREATE TABLE statements inside the caller transaction
preserve rollback of entity_state plus cognition schema as one bootstrap unit
fail closed on FK-off caller state without committing it
